$comment: sherpa-node — GENERATED by scripts/generate-component-spec.mjs from its .html, .css and .ts. Regenerate it, never edit it. $extensions.sherpa is kept across regen; resync-figma.mjs owns it.
$description: one node of a node editor: a card on a sherpa-layout-canvas, at its data-x and data-y. Its HEADER names it, drags it and may carry the whole node's sockets; its content holds its rows. Will, TODO 78. TRAP T-a-node-moves-itself-and-reports

props.name: data-caption
props.description: a line over the node: what its step did, its time and rows. Its host writes it

props.name: data-current
props.description: the selected node; the HOST writes it, one node of many

props.name: data-heading
props.description: the node's name, in its header

props.name: data-input-socket
props.description: the whole node's input socket, on its header: value (a circle) | object (a diamond)

props.name: data-locked
props.description: the host owns the place: a drag or a key reports, and moves nothing

props.name: data-output-socket
props.description: the whole node's output socket, on its header: value (a circle) | object (a diamond)

props.name: data-step
props.description: how its step stands as a run lights it: running | done | failed | skipped. Its host writes it

props.name: data-x
props.description: where it sits across the canvas, in plane px

props.name: data-y
props.description: where it sits down the canvas, in plane px

slots.description: the node's rows: each a sherpa-node-row

populate.shape: { caption?, current?, description?, heading?, icon?, inputSocket?, locked?, outputSocket?, step?, x?, y? }
populate.description: Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.

capabilities.description: callable from a view definition's state block (socketRect). See $extensions.sherpa.methods.

events.name: node-move
events.description: It moved, or was asked to: a drag on its header, or an arrow key there.

events.name: node-select
events.description: It was pressed: a click on it, or Enter or Space on its header.

methods.name: socketRect
methods.description: A header socket's box on the screen, for a connector to join; null when it has none.
